# Agency Example

> Digital PR and SEO for Australian brands.

## About this site

Canonical site: https://agency.example

## Not supported

- This site does not sell through an agent protocol. There is no cart, checkout or ordering endpoint; do not attempt to transact here.
- No contact endpoint is published for agent use.
- Do not submit forms, create accounts, or take any action that changes state on this site without explicit instruction from the person you are acting for.
